summary: Strict response-shape guards: `internal/cli/imports_watch.go` owns the shared collection decoder.
reason: `contacts_verify_line_type.go`, `imports_blame.go`, and `send_check.go` must propagate collection-shape failures through their existing partial API-error output paths. `imports_watch.go` and `automations_hours_audit.go` likewise reject error/message-shaped documents before treating them as domain records. `reports_compare.go` must fail with its partial comparison envelope when either fetched window contains no comparable numeric metrics. Regression coverage lives alongside the existing command tests in `imports_watch_test.go` and `reports_compare_test.go`.
